title: YEA, Lord, I give myself wholy to Thee

lines.text: YEA, Lord, I give myself wholy to Thee Only Thy priceless love give Thou me.
All I have, all I am, body and soul Nothing refuse I Thee, take the whole.
Only abide with me, Lord, to the end Jesus, Emmanuel, Saviour, Friend.
And when Thy time is come, let me adore Thee in Thy home of light ever more.
